mechanism_claims.claim_text: Bottromycin D is supported as a ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptide product of the bst cluster in WMMB272.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper proposes specific tailoring steps but says further work is required to confirm that the identified cluster contains all necessary biosynthetic genes.
